notice: Published offers, not an entitlement or live quota check. No automatic billing or provider fallback.

gemini.name: Gemini Developer API
gemini.offer: Free input/output for Gemini Flash TTS; account/model rate limits apply. Pro TTS is not free.
gemini.cautions: Account/region eligibility applies. Review applicable data-use terms; do not submit sensitive material to a demo account.

groq.name: Groq Orpheus
groq.offer: Free Plan: Orpheus 10 requests/minute, 100/day, plus token limits; 200 input characters/request.
groq.cautions: Only six English voices. Tags count towards the 200-character cap. Quotas can differ by account.

hume.name: Hume Octave
hume.cautions: Octave 1 is selected for acting instructions. Octave 2 description support is not yet documented as available. Use an Octave-1-compatible voice; check plan licensing.

cartesia.name: Cartesia Sonic
cartesia.offer: Free: 20,000 credits/month; consumption depends on the model.
cartesia.cautions: Free is for non-commercial testing; pricing places commercial use on paid plans. Emotion control is guidance, not exact acting.

elevenlabs.name: ElevenLabs
elevenlabs.offer: Free API allowance: 10,000 characters for v3; model-specific allowances and restrictions apply.
elevenlabs.cautions: Review free-plan attribution and commercial-use restrictions. Some voices/models/formats are plan restricted.

azure.name: Azure Speech
azure.cautions: Select F0 explicitly; S0 is a different billing tier. Styles depend on voice and region. Resource/account eligibility applies.

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
cloudflare.offer: 10,000 Neurons/day shared across Workers AI models; resets at 00:00 UTC.
cloudflare.cautions: Direct REST; no Worker deployment required. Free plan stops at quota, while paid plans can charge overage. No free-form acting control.

google.name: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech
google.offer: Monthly free usage: Neural2 1M characters; Standard/WaveNet pricing lists 4M. Default here is Neural2.
google.cautions: Billing and API enablement required; overages may auto-charge. Distinct from Gemini Developer API. OAuth access token is supported as an alternative; Chirp/Gemini Cloud voices are not selected by this adapter.

voicerss.name: Voice RSS
voicerss.offer: Free: 350 requests/day; text limit 100 KB/request; this skill uses much shorter clips.
voicerss.cautions: Basic narration/preview, not theatrical emotional control. SSML is not part of the free plan; adapter sends plain text.

deepgram.name: Deepgram Aura
deepgram.offer: One-time $200 credit for new accounts; not a recurring free allowance.
deepgram.cautions: Pricing advertises no credit card for trial. Verify your credit balance/expiry before use. Voice is selected through the model ID; no free-form acting control.

polly.name: Amazon Polly
polly.offer: New AWS accounts since 2025-07-15: up to $200 credits, free plan up to six months. Legacy Polly quotas are eligibility-dependent.
polly.cautions: Not permanent free TTS. Use least-privilege credentials; temporary credentials also need AWS_SESSION_TOKEN. No AWS SDK/CLI is required by this skill.

mistral.name: Mistral Voxtral TTS
mistral.offer: Speech API is documented; a guaranteed free TTS quota could not be verified. Check model access and price in your workspace.
mistral.cautions: Not advertised by this package as verified free. Preset/saved voice identity is supported; no unsupported instruction field is fabricated. No automatic reference-audio upload/cloning.

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.offer: No universal recurring free TTS API tier is assumed.
openai.cautions: ChatGPT/Codex subscription does not supply TTS API credits. Kept as an optional explicitly selected paid backend.
